If you have a great passion for modern networking technologies, and you are driven by your energy to identify and resolve complex problems with an aptitude for learning new technologies, this position offers numerous growth opportunities and a long-lasting career with SOTI. What You’ll Do Work closely with Quality Engineering Team as a Network expert to build, test and ensure from a networking standpoint the product quality remains paramount Design, build and maintain complex enterprise-like networking test environments to simulate real-world customer deployments Set up and maintain virtualized and containerized test labs for scalable QA validation, which utilizes network constructs including LAN/WAN, VPN, Proxy, Firewall, VLAN, DNS, DHCP, Load Balancer and Wi-Fi based enterprise environments Collaborate with Dev Ops, Infrastructure, Network and Security teams for QA environment setup and troubleshooting Validate application behavior under varying network conditions such as packet loss, latency, bandwidth throttling, failover and unstable connectivity Monitor infrastructure health and ensure system availability during testing cycles Ensure compliance with organizational and regulatory standards Experience You’ll Bring Must Haves 4–6 years of hands-on experience in enterprise networking environments with strong exposure to Microsoft technologies such as Windows Server, Active Directory, Microsoft Defender, and Microsoft cloud networking solutions, along with a strong passion for delivering high-quality solutions.
